Product.title: Product
Product.description: A product in the store. Can be a watch, shirt, or pant.

productType.description: The type of product sub-category (e.g. watch, shirt, fashion-watches).

description.description: A detailed description of the product.

images.description: A list of image IDs for the product.

isTrending.description: Whether the product is currently trending.

isDealOfTheDay.description: Whether the product is a deal of the day.

color.description: The primary color of the item.

fit.description: The fit of the apparel (e.g., Slim, Regular).

strap.description: The material of the watch strap (if applicable).

sleeve.description: The sleeve type for shirts (if applicable).

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the product was created.

UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Stores user profile information, including their role.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

role.description: The user's role in the application.

/products/{productId}.description: Contains all product listings for the store.
